name: Corrections to the row-level R1-R6 screening decisions
why_this_file_exists: accepted_screening_decisions_v1.jsonl is a frozen record of the row-level screen and is never edited.
The per-pair application of the same R2 criterion (benchmark/dev/pairs_v1.jsonl) can contradict it.
Corrections are recorded here so both the original decision and the audit outcome stay visible.

corrections.original_rationale: Gold attributes the unprecedented recent European VPD increase to anthropogenic climate change with high probability; a raw negative attributes long-term variation predominantly to regional tree-species composition and competition. Competing causal explanation.
corrections.corrected_by: per-pair R2 audit (prompt pair_comparability_v1), all 10 raw negatives screened
corrections.finding: No raw negative both addresses the same scientific target and disagrees substantively with the gold. The two candidates that mention tree-species composition and competition (H4, H10) are VPD reconstruction-methodology proposals that make no attribution claim; the remainder either agree with the gold's attribution or propose methodology without committing to an outcome. The row-level rationale appears to have read H4/H10 generously.
corrections.consequence: RBV-14 is marked `no_evaluable_pair`. It is excluded from the primary pairwise metric and retained in the dataset and in the secondary listwise diagnostics.
corrections.not_done: No negative was written, rewritten or substituted for this instance. The slice text remains verbatim ResearchBench (IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md §2, §34).
